label_safe_zones.description: Reserve readable zones for section labels, area names, axes, room names, server names, route labels, or timeline labels before placing interactive objects.
rules: Labels define spatial meaning and must not be covered by cards, glows, badges, or objects.
Objects should snap around label zones or labels should move to protected layers.
If a label is intentionally secondary, fade it deliberately but keep it legible enough to orient the user.
Use collision detection or layout constraints when objects are draggable or dynamic.
rejected: labels clipped by viewport or scroll container

primary_object_map.description: When a map, floor plan, seating chart, or timeline is the product object, it should own the command surface.
rules: Keep the map/canvas/timeline visually central.
Use panels as inspectors, filters, queues, or action surfaces.
Do not reduce the product object to one generic card among many.
Provide clear selected state between object and inspector.

placebo_navigation_guard.description: Navigation/tabs over spatial products must change visible content, object scope, mode, route, filter, or selected panel.
rules: Active nav state must correspond to visible product state.
If a tab is not implemented, disable it or remove it.
If a tab is a filter, the filtered result must visibly change.
Do not leave the same map and inspector visible while only changing selected styling.

pattern_canvas_label_lanes.description: Pattern drafting canvases need explicit label lanes, callout routes, badge safe zones, and measurement hierarchy before pieces are drawn.
rules: Reserve lanes for piece names, measurement labels, status chips, and construction notes.
Route callouts outside pattern geometry unless the label belongs inside the piece.
Badges and selected outlines must not cover piece names, measurements, axes, ruler labels, or construction lines.
Zoom states should reveal more clarity, not more overlap.
rejected: piece names covered by status badges
construction lines running through important text
close-up state becoming visually noisier than overview state

canvas_performance_budget.description: Interactive canvas-like products need a rendering/performance budget before adding dense labels, shadows, glows, filters, drag, pan, zoom, or selection effects.
rules: Define expected object count and label count.
Choose SVG, Canvas/Konva, D3, React Flow, or HTML based on interaction and density.
Avoid repeated expensive shadows, filters, glows, and layout-triggering interactions.
Use culling, virtualization, precomputed layout, or Canvas/Konva when object density grows.
rejected: performance budget missing from visual spec
